FAQ

Questions, answered.

Everything you need to know about Saro, from setup to security. Still curious? Our team is one message away.

Online now

Still have questions?

Talk to a real person. We reply in under two hours.

Talk to us

Talk to us

How long does it take to set up Saro?

Most teams are live in under 15 minutes. Connect your bank accounts, invite your team and Saro starts syncing transactions right away.

Is my company’s money safe with Saro?

Funds are held with regulated partner banks, and every account is protected with bank-grade encryption, two-factor sign-in and role-based access.

Which banks and tools can I connect?

Saro connects to over 12,000 banks worldwide, plus the tools you already use for accounting, payroll and invoicing.

How do multi-currency accounts work?

Open local accounts in 40 currencies, hold balances in each one and convert at the live rate whenever you need to pay out.

Can I set spend limits for my team?

Yes. Issue virtual or physical cards with limits by person, team or merchant, and approvals route automatically above any amount you choose.

What does Saro AI do with my data?

Saro AI only reads your workspace to answer your questions. Your data is never used to train shared models.

Is there a free plan?

Yes. The Starter plan is free for small teams, and you can upgrade to Growth or Scale whenever you need more seats or features.

Can I cancel anytime?

Of course. Plans are month to month, and you can export all of your data in one click before you leave.
